Hi Logan / Elena —

Thanks for looping me in. A short interim continuity affirmation is acceptable for our purposes provided it:

- Explicitly states the covered dates (report end date and interim period)
- Discloses any material changes to controls or states none observed
- Is signed by an officer with authority (title and printed name)
- Ideally references the original SOC 2 report by date and identifier

Otherwise the standard "no material changes" phrasing will suffice.

I can review the draft once received; please send to me directly and cc procurement/security (Elena).
